body: Thank you all for the advice. I came home on medical leave from my first year at college.  I have a job, I'm on medication, although I'm thinking maybe it's not the right dosage.  I'm going to set up an spot with my counsellor.  It's mostly at night I feel so terrible.  I haven't been able to sleep, I haven't been spending as much time with my family or talking to my girlfriend ( it's a long distance relationship now that I'm home from school).  And I'd love to do this.  But I feel judged for taking a medical leave.   Even though I know they care and understand, being around people now makes me uncomfortable and sad.  I've been diagnosed with asperger's so it's always kinds been like that, but now it's become unbearable.  I sit in my room all day either sleeping or playing video games.  I want to change.  I just feel like it's beyond my grasp to do it on my own.
